entries.title: II Corinthians 1:8
segments: Our affliction which befell us in Asia.  This affliction is believed to have been a severe illness at Ephesus.

entries.title: II Corinthians 1:11
segments: The gift bestowed upon us by means of many. The gift was Paul's health restored through the prayers of many.  Paul was a firm believer in the efficacy of united prayers.  See

entries.title: II Corinthians 1:15
segments: To come first unto you.  Paul had planned to visit the Corinthians on his way to Macedonia, and again as he returned.  His defense against fickleness indicates that this charge had been brought against him.  See note

entries.title: II Corinthians 1:17
segments: According to the flesh... the yea yea and the nay nay.  This is a denial that he would say one thing meaning another.

entries.title: II Corinthians 1:22
segments: @ The earnest of the Spirit.  Earnest money was a small sum paid to bind a bargain.  The earnest of the Spirit is a pledge of complete salvation.
